title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 487  An Act Converting the Manlabang Barangay High School in the Municipality of Caibiran, Province of Leyte, Into a National High School to Be Known as Manlabang National High School.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 487  An Act Converting the Manlabang Barangay High School in the Municipality of Caibiran, Province of Leyte, Into a National High School to Be Known as Manlabang National High School.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Manlabang Barangay tại Thị trấn Caibiran, Tỉnh Leyte thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Manlabang Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Manlabang Barangay ในเทศบาล Caibiran จังหวัด Leyte เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Manlabang แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Manlabang Barangay di Kotamadya Caibiran, Provinsi Leyte menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Manlabang Nasional

text.en:
The Manlabang Barangay High School in the Municipality of Caibiran, Province of Leyte, is
hereby converted into a national high school to be known as Manlabang National High School. The
curriculum of said school shall include both academic and vocational courses.

The Minister of Education, Culture and Sports is directed to take such steps as are necessary for
the conversion of the school and the immediate implementation of this Act.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports
intended for new national high schools and an additional amount corresponding to fifty percent of its share in
the budgetary aid actually paid to it before such conversion shall be released for its operation from the
national assistance fund to local schools. Thereafter, the amount needed for its operation and maintenance
shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
